about: The Discover prompt test for The Ninth Facet (server/scripts/eval_discover.py). These characters are taken OUT of the cast, so Discover should find each one in every chapter that names them; the rest stay cast and must never be proposed, under any name. 'not_characters' are named things the book lists as objects — proposing one is a false positive. 'real_extras' are genuine minor people the book's character list does not have — proposing them is correct.
